d:
A companion comic to Fallout Unsheltered Squadron 32, meant to separate the robot-specific intermissions from USqs32. It's not really a full blown comic with a storyline, but more an occasional 4koma for sexy situations.
Decided to post higher resolutions to test if it's more comfortable to read for public reading. Highest resolution still on Patreon.

Content: Mostly female centric with more "male on female" (implied or explicit) than usual, along with the usual "futa on female" and "female on female" (though far less yuri content on this one). Feel free to suggest more content type for that one!

NOTE TO TRANSLATORS: I allow (and encourage) the translation of every single one of my comics, but please do not use the Patreon-exclusive high resolution pages. Thank you.
